tests.description: Valid, invalid and boundary requests match the admitted CapabilityDefinition request schema.
Every terminal response carries exactly one admitted result or error shape.
Retries obey the declared idempotency scope and reject one key with a different request digest.

The Provider rejects a wrong JWS typ, algorithm or key and any mismatch in Tenant, ClientApplication, Principal context, WorkOrder, ProviderResolution/Instance/Revision/Audience, Attempt, fencing, request, executable policy/budget/permissions or StagingGrant claims.
A stale fencing token cannot mutate state and attempt-local Event sequence remains contiguous and idempotent.
Oversized encoded request bodies are rejected with 413 before JSON parsing or Provider work begins.
Observed side effects do not exceed the CapabilityDefinition classification or approved policy.

Invoke, Status, Cancel and Event tokens are operation-bound. Invoke execution authority cannot predate Policy, Budget or Artifact grants and remains inside the original deadline and CommercialAuthorization; post-expiry safety-control lineage permits only Status, Cancel and Event reconciliation and cannot use expired Artifact grants or create new side effects.
Event reads bind a normalized attempt-local cursor descriptor and resume without gaps; unavailable history fails explicitly.

A compatibility Plugin bridge preserves its closed JWS Header Profile, Tenant, ClientApplication, WorkOrder, original Invocation digest, deadline, Attempt and fencing bindings; Invoke execution stays inside Deadline/Artifact windows, while post-expiry safety-control permits only Status, Cancel and Event without Artifact or new side-effect authority. Distinct Contract/Profile/Digest values reject path, cursor and cross-operation replay.

Input ArtifactGrants bind the Capability Tenant, WorkOrder and InvocationAttempt; output uses an ArtifactStagingGrant plus shorter Artifact Gateway operation tokens, and the Provider cannot finalize ArtifactVersions.
Provider results contain bounded UsageObservation evidence; Platform assigns TechnicalUsageEntry identity, attribution, idempotency and recorded_at.
The Provider cannot exceed approved permissions, budget or gateway requirements.
